mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the past two months signal broad-based demand contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 2.5% and sustained for three months), higher discount rates and reduced risk appetite cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past two months signals manufacturing sector weakness, reducing corporate earnings growth and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in annualized CPIAUCSL above 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real GDP (GDPC1) over the past six months signal a broad economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and GDPC1 decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During labor market tightness (UNRATE below 3.5% and PAYEMS growth above 0.5% monthly), strong consumer spending and corporate earnings growth produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during labor market tightness, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
